name: 3DGS-VEval-Bench
description: Benchmarks 3D visual reasoning and evaluation for models working with geometric scenes and object-level tasks (e.g., pose estimation, grasp prediction, view understanding). It measures how well vision or embodied agents can interpret 3D scene structure and produce actionable outputs for downstream robotics/interaction tasks. Designed to stress 3D perception and scene reasoning capabilities.
reputation: Niche dataset used within 3D vision and robotics research communities; limited but growing visibility.
